coverage: Reported segments · continuing and discontinued operations
definition: Reported segment profit/loss before interest and tax, before common unallocated expenses, other income and exceptional items. It is not net profit. Discontinued segments are explicitly marked.

rows.name: Solar power generation and related activities

location: PDF page 16 · consolidated segment table; pages 17–18 · discontinued-operation notes
notes: Source ₹ lakh divided by 100 for ₹ crore. Rows include continuing and discontinued businesses in the same year. Total segment revenue ₹2,411.6369 crore less ₹134.9018 crore discontinued revenue gives ₹2,276.7351 crore continuing revenue. Row PBIT sum ₹324.1517 crore less ₹26.9673 crore common unallocated expenses gives ₹297.1844 crore EBIT across both scopes. Removing discontinued segment losses gives ₹337.1891 crore continuing EBIT. Finance, other income, exceptional items and tax still affect net profit. Power trading, refrigerants and green mobility are classified as discontinued in this annual disclosure; that does not prove every legal transfer had completed.
insight: Ash and coal handling contributes most segment earnings. Wind has sales but much less segment PBIT; discontinued mobility records a loss. Solar generation is also explicitly reported within this company.
